messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: spike of 5xx errors from apac-edge egress-proxy v2 after rollout stage. 5m error rate 4.8% -> alerts triggered.
sara (oncall): I'm on it, paging infra + runtime. tagging @mike @jen.
mike (eng-runtime): seeing 503s with backend header mismatch in traces, looks like some requests hitting a v1-only backend. short tail of timeouts ~200ms then 503.
jen (infra): APAC edge weights show partial traffic to new egress pool (weight 20%). DNS TTLs still ~30s, but edges appear sticky. could be edge cache not honoring upstream header.
sara (oncall): quick impact check — lia, can you estimate customer impact?
lia (support): early numbers: ~5 enterprise customers seeing elevated errors, ~0.9% of total platform requests from apac region. top affected customers: AcmeCorp, BetaFin. Tickets opened.
mike (eng-runtime): root cause hypothesis: proxy shim for egress_v2 forgot `X-Egress-Version` header for routed traffic, so some backends reject requests (404 -> translated to 503). replicated locally.
sara (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) flip feature flag `egress_v2` off globally 2) purge APAC edge caches 3) rollback release rel-2026-03-17-erp if needed 4) follow up with canary config fix. doing step 1 now.
jen (infra): ready to help with purge + dns weight adjustments.
sara (oncall): running flag command:
```
flagctl set egress_v2 false --scope=global --reason "emergency rollback: apac egress mismatch"
```
ops-bot: Flag `egress_v2` set to false by sara (oncall) — effective immediately.
mike (eng-runtime): flag off accepted. starting canary rollback plan:
```
rctl rollback rel-2026-03-17-erp --to rel-2026-03-10-stable --region apac
```
jen (infra): purging edge caches for APAC now:
```
edgectl purge --region apac --pattern "edge-*" --async
```
ops-bot: purge jobs queued (3 shards).
lia (support): customer comms draft in #support-commits, recommending notice: "brief disruption, mitigated, follow-up postmortem".
mike (eng-runtime): quick log snippet from a failing request:
```
[2026-03-17T07:12:03Z] req=0x7a3f egress_version= -> backend returned 404: /v1/generate
```
sara (oncall): rolling back now, will report when error rate normalizes. setting incident severity to P2, paging rotation oncall notified.
jen (infra): also bumping dns weights back to primary pool just in case (manual reroute).
jen (infra): command used:
```
dnsctl set-weight apac-egress-primary 100 --region apac
```
mike (eng-runtime): rollback completed for apac by rel controller, traces look healthier.
ops-bot: Rolling forward healthchecks show 5xx spike subsided.
sara (oncall): metrics: error rate dropped from 4.8% -> 0.2% within 3m after flag flip + rollback. latency back to baseline ~120ms.
lia (support): updated affected customer tickets with mitigation note and ETA for postmortem.
sara (oncall): handing off to sam for next shift and postmortem coordination. summary: emergency rollback of rel-2026-03-17-erp due to missing X-Egress-Version header causing partial apac egress mismatch. actions taken: flag off, rollback, edge purge, dns weight reset. impact: ~0.9% requests; 5 enterprise customers. severity: P2.
sam (oncall-next): acknowledged. I'll pick this up for the postmortem, will schedule RCA meeting and check deployment pipeline gating.
ops-bot: oncall handoff recorded: from sara to sam at 07:45 UTC.
sara (oncall): monitoring for 20m, will join RCA. closing active mitigation.
sam (oncall-next): will follow up with a detailed action item list: fix header shim, add e2e canary test for header invariants, make flag kill path tested in staging.
sara (oncall): thanks team :thumbsup: keeping thread open for notes.
